sources.note: The only located source carrying the Main Boundary Thrust and Main Central Thrust as line geometry. IMPORTANT: these shapefiles have NO name attribute - the only columns are Id, ltype (a cartographic line-type code) and Shape_Leng. A fault's identity comes from the FILENAME, so every feature is marked identity_from='source filename'.

sources.licence: licence not stated in repository; cite Taylor & Yin 2009, doi:10.1130/GES00217.1
sources.note: 940 traces across the Himalaya and Tibet. Carries fault NAMES, the originating REFERENCE and NET SLIP RATES, all three of which the GEM harmonisation drops. Contains the Main Frontal Thrust; contains neither the Main Boundary Thrust nor the Main Central Thrust.

The layer production already uses. VERIFIED 2026-10-28: all 57 features inside the Nepal window carry catalog_name='HimaTibetMap', so within Nepal this source is a strict subset of himatibetmap with fewer attributes. Kept in the registry because it is global and may contribute outside the Himalayan compilation's footprint.

properties.absence_note: Faults listed in known_absent are not present in any source merged here. This block is DERIVED from the built layer on every run, never hardcoded, so it cannot go stale when a source is added or removed.
